top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa; targeted protein degradation by induced proximity) is a new designable chemical principle with a quantitatively measured, independently reproduced ternary-complex mechanism and demonstrated consequences through cereblon-dependent glue drugs already in patients. The citation is worded around the principle, not drugs, and the three-name allocation (PROTAC concept and proof of principle, plus cereblon identification) is compact and defensible, although Ciulli, Sakamoto, Kim, Gray and Ito are omitted by the three-person limit. P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig, C-N coupling) is mature and cleanly attributed but less of a game-changer after the 2010 C-C coupling prize; I rank it above no award.
